purpose: Discoverability evaluation (REA practice): broad, direct and negative tasks. Run each prompt in a fresh session with the plugin installed and record which skill is selected, arguments, errors and outcome.

expect_kinetic.prompt: Use Kinetic to redesign the onboarding of my Flutter app.
My iOS app looks cheap and generic, can you make it feel premium?
Design the home screen of a meditation app in SwiftUI.
Create a design system (colors, typography, spacing) for my React Native app.
The animations in my Compose app feel bouncy and cheap, fix them.
Draw me a consistent set of custom SVG icons for my mobile app's tab bar.
What's wrong with the UX of this checkout screen? (Dart file attached)
Extract the design tokens my Flutter codebase actually uses.
Mon app mobile a des couleurs incohérentes et un mode sombre raté, refais le système de couleurs.
Ajoute des états vides et d'erreur dignes de ce nom à mes écrans SwiftUI.

expect_not_kinetic.prompt: Build a landing page for my SaaS.
Fix this null pointer exception in my Flutter repository class.
Set up CI for my iOS app with GitHub Actions.
Write the Supabase schema for my app's users table.
Make a slide deck about our Q3 results.
